title: DEP-470: checkout-api v4.7 regional rollout
body: 2026-09-17 14:03 UTC: checkout-api v4.7 rolled out to ap-south-1, replacing v4.6.9. Release manifest includes PR-1842. Four workers per replica retained. Startup checks passed; this record does not establish behavior under live load. payment-api, fraud-service, and provider-adapter were not deployed in this window.
